packageRules.description: Supply-chain hardening (Art. X): wait 7 days before proposing newly published versions
Group non-major devDependency bumps into one PR
Keep the pinned pnpm packageManager field current

node is a floor here, not a pin, in both places it appears. `engines` says >=22 on purpose and .npmrc sets engine-strict, so an exact value locks every install out of every machine that is not on that patch — CI included. `node-version` in the workflows names a major so setup-node uses the toolchain already on the runner; an exact one makes it fetch a build from actions/node-versions, which the harden-runner egress allowlist refuses (ECONNREFUSED). Renovate proposed both in #79 and CI went red on the second.

description: minimatch is in ignoreDeps because patches/minimatch@3.1.5.patch applies to that exact version and Renovate does not read pnpm patchedDependencies. pnpm-workspace.yaml pins it too; the pin, the patch and this entry move together, by hand, or not at all. The pin's override key is `minimatch@3`, which Renovate reads as its own depName — bare `minimatch` does not match it, and #111 slipped through that gap and broke install by orphaning the patch. Both spellings stay listed.
